The studio

Deliberately local

One landscape.
One accountable team.

JLE is a small landscape practice serving Kitsap County. We combine design judgment, construction craft, horticultural knowledge, and long-term care so the finished garden feels coherent from its first season—and grows more beautiful with time.

Design direction · site planning · stone and water · planting · construction · stewardship

The process

Clarity from first
walk-through to maturity.

  1. 01

    Consultation & site walk

    We listen, study the property, and establish the ambition and practical requirements.

  2. 02

    Concept & master plan

    A unified direction for circulation, grade, views, materials, water, and planting.

  3. 03

    Design development

    Details, selections, and construction decisions are resolved before work begins.

  4. 04

    Build & planting

    Our team shapes the site and installs each element with exacting care.

  5. 05

    Stewardship

    Seasonal attention guides establishment and preserves the design intent.

JLE Garden Stewardship

The garden is finished.
The relationship continues.

Thoughtful seasonal care helps planting establish, responds to change, and protects the original composition. Stewardship is offered to JLE clients as an ongoing design service—not routine yard maintenance.
